[Verse 1]
Ferry late, the harbor grey
I count the gulls drifting away
Damp coat, my coffee going cold
The schedule lied, the tide is old

[Chorus]
Wait for the horn, wait for the light
Everyone gets across tonight

## Adaptation notes
# Kept: title idea (the late ferry), first-person voice, gulls / damp coat / cold coffee / old tide images, refrain line "Everyone gets across tonight", rhyme schemes AABB and AA
# Changed: Verse 1 lines 1-4 -> 7-8 syllables each (source 9-11); stress follows the 4/4 straight-eighth pulse
# Changed: "the timetable lied but the tide is old" -> "the schedule lied, the tide is old" (shorter, same meaning)
# Changed: Chorus line 1 -> "wait for the horn, wait for the light" (repeat replaces "and", same two images)
# Risks: line 3 opens on two stressed words (damp coat) and needs a short breath before it; "schedule" is a diction swap for "timetable"
